criteria.assertion: Given exact original owner model/action bytes and explicitly supplied semantic Registry/context, when I inspect and prepare a plan model, then exact portable action pins, set effect, Field/input/frames and complete interpreted dependencies are checked with existing owner semantics, preserving installed callbacks; executor-local revisions are not portable identities and SQL cannot register an action.

Given unknown plan/model content or malformed recognized members, when I inspect and round-trip it, then original bytes/content remain recoverable and relevant unknown meaning blocks eligibility with source-qualified diagnostics.

Given exact capability profiles with defined claims/evidence and owner action obligations, when I assess one unchanged original plan using the explicit Registry/context, then each action/selection/manifest/bulk/guard/snapshot obligation is independently assessed; missing or unauthenticated evidence cannot imply execution verification.

Given supported exact boolean/integer/string literals and incompatible optional/null/key-changing/handler inputs, when I inspect, then supported values preserve spelling and unsupported executable shapes refuse without coercion.
Given the shared corpus, when Bun and actual Chromium inspect/assess it, then copied outputs and ordered diagnostics agree without native I/O, state evaluation or host globals.

Given duplicate JSON members, unpaired surrogates, overflowing bytes/depth/nodes or a mutated owner preparation artifact, when inspection/preparation runs with an explicit Registry, then it refuses without partial eligible output and preserves the original input/callback registry.

Given exact local-owner actor/policy/invocation declarations, preparation admits only the complete known bundle against original action semantics; mixed native/local, unknown versions and incomplete resources refuse, preserving native tx1 and historical sources.

Given a retained plan and manifest with three items and batchSize2, when inspected, then only the full-first [2,1] partition and exact constants/frames/identities are admitted; the underfilled [1,2] partition and missing/extra/duplicate work refuse.

Given whitespace-distinct, tampered or store/epoch-mismatched artifacts, when inspected, then actual UTF-8 digests and scope are checked while original bytes remain retained; no canonical reserialization may rewrite queued intent.
Given empty work and boundary/overflow cases, when inspected, then empty batches accompany empty items, exact finite boundaries are enforced and overflow yields no eligible partial work.

Given a schema-valid client manifest, when assessed, then snapshot completeness, native guard issuance, current authorization and atomic replay remain separate unverified obligations; portable inspection cannot seal or execute.

Given every bulk/control result including submit conflict/refusal, known control noncommit, lost seal/submit/claim/cancel/reconcile acknowledgement and recovered original sampled state, when outcome schemas validate, then complete unions preserve immutable original control results and native/business uncertainty without later-state reconstruction or fresh-token permission.

Given owner-authored portable manifest/bulk fixtures and independent expected outcomes, when Bun/Chromium inspection and the separately coded Python test consumer run, then each agrees with the independent oracle; identical shared-implementation output alone is insufficient.

Given exact original plan bytes, resolved-action and snapshot basis declarations, ordered selected entity/guard rows and their original core Key tuple receipts, construction verifies every receipt against the pinned model, derives all action inputs/frame versions and deterministic batches, and returns an unsealed Artifact or atomically refuses. Receipt source/identity/value/bytes substitution, unknown members, duplicate work, overflow and malformed input refuse; no native selection, ordering, authorization or seal is attested.

Given native or local-owner invocation intent, portable manifest construction retains the exact original profile/pins and assessment selects the corresponding exact bulk companion/claims; native delegated-human and local-owner claims cannot substitute and execution remains unverified.
